description: A blank Excel workbook the organiser fills in and hands back: Name, Level, Gender, Comments, one player per row, with a sheet explaining each column. Offer it when the organiser has no list ready, asks how to send their players, or would rather work in a spreadsheet than paste names into chat. Needs no key. The file comes back both as a download link and as an attachable file. Reading a filled-in sheet needs no tool: parse it yourself and send the rows to add_players.
name: get_player_template
title: Get the player-list template
